gen-gf-oxanium-gf-lexend-giga: Lexend Giga spreads flat, single-weight letters wide apart, so each word gets room to open up. And Oxanium sits above it with a tall lowercase and unbroken monoline strokes, giving the page a sharper, more distinctive lead.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-julius-sans-one: Scattered, loud, and oddly weightless, Paprika fills its lines with lowercase that stands as tall as capitals. But Julius Sans One is the real anchor here, a plain sans whose wide gaps between letters and open curves give the pair its spacious quality.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-lexend-peta: Lexend Peta reads like a plain sans with a big, wide-mouthed c and curves that never thin out. Over a long page it stays smooth.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-lexend-zetta: Stencil cuts and tall lowercase make Snowburst One look like spray paint on a template. Yet Lexend Zetta, a plain sans of constant-width strokes and wide tracking, would carry a long passage without any fuss.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-lexend-mega: Tektur gives every curve a generous opening and strokes that look bent from pipe cleaner, with lowercase built oversized. Lexend Mega, a sans drawn as if with one nib, keeps a long stretch of text steady, its body height nearly matching the capitals.
gen-tourney-gf-cascadia-mono: Tourney cuts every stroke to one width and stretches its words wide, with bulky small letters. And Cascadia Mono, a plain sans with compact, pin-like letters, gives that loud heading a tidy, modern line to sit over.
gen-tourney-gf-julius-sans-one: Bulky small letters and wide tracking, all cut at one stroke width, define Tourney. Yet Julius Sans One, a plain sans with open curves and generous gaps, makes the pair's strongest quality its sharp contrast of heft against space.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-montserrat-alternate: Tilt Neon's tube-like, constant-width stroke and splayed c terminal make it glow even without color. It leads with presence, while Montserrat Alternates, a plain sans, does the quieter work of being read.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-lexend-exa: Commanding from the first line, Unica One draws a very large lowercase eye and every stroke at one thickness. Lexend Exa, a sans-serif with wide-open curves and stubby ascenders, handles the quieter work of staying distinct and clear.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-lexend-giga: Commanding and a little stenciled, Wallpoet lets the paper show through between letters while its lowercase rises high above the line. Lexend Giga, a sans, answers with flat, widely tracked strokes.
